concept.title: Notes and admonitions
concept.shortdesc: Every DITA note type maps to a GOV.UK component: inset text for neutral notes, warning text for the rest.

conbody.p: Neutral note types render as inset text:
conbody.note: A plain note renders as inset text with no label.
A tip also renders as inset text.
conbody.p: Warning-family note types render as warning text with the icon and a visually hidden label for screen readers:
conbody.note: A warning uses the warning text component.
A caution renders the same way, with its own hidden label.
Important notes join the warning family.
